hook_en: When your heart is faint, call to Him. 🙏
reflect_en: David prayed from the ends of the earth with a fainting heart, and he didn't ask for more strength of his own; he asked God to lead him to the rock that is higher than he is. If today feels like too much, you can pray the same prayer, because He has been your refuge before.
q_en: Where do you need God to lead you to higher ground today?
x_en: I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
tiktok: When your heart is faint 🙏 Psalm 61:2–3 — Lead me to the rock that is higher than I
yt_title: Lead Me to the Rock That Is Higher Than I | Psalm 61:2–3 #Shorts
li_open: Every leader eventually hits the limit of their own strength.
li_quote: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
li_body: David didn't pretend to be strong; he called out to God and asked to be led to a rock higher than himself. Leaders who bring their own weariness to God in prayer, and give their people a place to do the same, build teams that stand on something firmer than any one person.
hook_es: Cuando tu corazón desmaye, clama a Él. 🙏
reflect_es: Desde el cabo de la tierra y con el corazón desmayado, David no pidió más fuerzas propias: le pidió a Dios que lo condujera a la peña más alta que él. Si hoy todo te parece demasiado, puedes hacer la misma oración, porque Él ya ha sido tu refugio.
q_es: ¿En qué necesitas que Dios te lleve a terreno más alto hoy?
x_es: Desde el cabo de la tierra clamaré a ti, cuando mi corazón desmayare: a la peña más alta que yo me conduzcas.
key_es: a la peña más alta que yo
